if $3 == 'northern'
move 'climb steps'
elsif $6 == 'northern'
move 'climb second steps'
elsif $9 == 'northern'
move 'climb third steps'
elsif $12 == 'northern'
move 'climb fourth steps'
else
echo "error: unique_map_movements can't find the right steps"
exit
end
break
end
}
